localAIGeneration.answer: INFERRED · AI analysisSEOasis methodology is a structured framework for Shopify growth, focusing on strategic positioning and operational execution. It is derived from evidence [1] (positioning), [2] (AI-Ready Collection Pages), [3] (Direct Access & Transparent Reporting), and [4] (founder Interview). To apply it to clients, one must first define the core public service pillar—building transactional clusters with products in the grid [2], ensuring nonbrand collection clicks [2], and translating client goals into clear plans [5]. This approach utilizes direct operator access via Friday reports and fortnightly strategy calls [3], maintaining a single source of truth for status and decisions [3], and employs quarterly post-mortems for scaling decisions [6]. The methodology ensures progress, risks, and next decisions are visible to the client, making progress, risks, and next decisions visible to the client [3]. [1]
